name: GetSubscriptionPrice

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the subscription duration. Valid values:

Year

Month
parameters.help_zh:
服务时长单位。取值范围：
Year：年。
Month：月
parameters.name: service_period_unit

parameters.help_en: The subscription type. The value is fixed as `Subscription`
parameters.help_zh: 订阅类型。取值类型：Subscription（预付费）
parameters.name: subscription_type

parameters.help_en:
The order type. Valid values:

`NewOrder`: a new purchase.

`Renewal`: a renewal.

`Upgrade`: an upgrade
parameters.help_zh:
订单类型。取值范围：
NewOrder：新购。
Renewal：续费。
Upgrade：升级
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en: The product type. Whether this parameter is required depends on the pricing documentation of the specific product
parameters.help_zh: 产品类型，是否必输以具体产品的询价文档为准
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en: The instance ID for which you want to query the price. This parameter is required for upgrades (when `OrderType` is set to `Upgrade`) to obtain the pre-upgrade configuration of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 指定询价的实例 ID，升级场景必须设置，用于获取实例升级前配置
parameters.name: instance_id

element_fields.help_en:
This parameter is required only when `OrderType` is set to `Upgrade`. It specifies the change status of the pricing module. Valid values:

1: Added.

2: Changed. If the configuration of a pricing module changes in an upgrade scenario, you must explicitly set this parameter to this value.

Default value: 1
element_fields.help_zh:
仅在订单类型为Upgrade（升级）时需要，表示此次询价模块变更状态。
取值范围：
1：新增。
2：变更，升级场景如果计价模块的配置发生变化需要显示指定此状态值。

默认值：1
element_fields.name: module_status

element_fields.help_zh: 第n个计价模块的模块标识
element_fields.name: module_code

element_fields.help_en: This parameter is required only for upgrades or downgrades of some products. It specifies the identifier of a specific resource. For example, if you change disk specifications, you can use this parameter to specify the disk ID
element_fields.help_zh: 仅在某些产品的升级变配中需要，代表指定资源的标识。例如：对于磁盘的变配，用Tag标识具体磁盘对应的Id
element_fields.name: tag

element_fields.help_en: The configuration of the pricing module. n is an integer from 1 to 50. The value must be in the "AA:aa,BB:bb" format. In this format, `AA` and `BB` are property identifiers of the pricing module, and `aa` and `bb` are their corresponding property values
element_fields.help_zh: 第n个计价模块的配置，n的取值范围为（1~50），格式：“AA:aa,BB:bb”，其中AA,BB分别为计价模块属性标识，aa,bb分别为计价模块属性的属性值
element_fields.name: config
